label: Independent creative project
title: An Ape in Infinity
standfirst: Somewhere between the animal and the absolute.
paragraphs: An Ape in Infinity is my podcast, and an open inquiry into the strange experience of being human.
It explores consciousness, philosophy, human potential, business, nature, technology, and where civilisation is headed.
Nothing to become. Everything to explore. A lifetime to play.

Lembert Studio and An Ape in Infinity are two expressions of the same curiosity. Lembert Studio is that curiosity applied to business, leadership and creation. An Ape in Infinity is the open version, with nothing to apply it to.
